Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.exceptions

package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.exceptions
Exceptions thrown by this library's Planning REST API client, rooted at PbcsClientException. Callers coding against com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client interfaces will encounter these when a request fails, a requested object doesn't exist, or the server returns an error the client can't otherwise recover from.
Author:
Jason Jones

    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client
    The main public API for the PBCS/EPM Cloud Planning REST API: PbcsPlanningClient for the connection, PbcsApplication for an application, PbcsPlanType for a cube, and PbcsMember for outline members.
    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl
    Default implementation of the com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client API.
    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.memberdimensioncache
    Pluggable caching strategies for member/dimension lookups and aliases, implementing PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache and PbcsPlanType.MemberResolver.
    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso
    OAuth/IDCS authentication flows (authorization code, device code, JWT assertion) for connecting to EPM Cloud environments that require single sign-on rather than native username/password credentials.
  • Class
    Description
    PbcsClientException
    Base class from which all PBCS Client exception should be derived from.
    PbcsClientException.PbcsErrorResponse
    Maps the various shapes of error payload the PBCS REST API can return, used by PbcsClientException.createException(org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpResponse, java.lang.String) to build a PbcsGeneralException.
    PbcsDataExportException
    Thrown when a retrieve/export data slice operation fails, such as in PbcsPlanType.retrieve(PovGrid, PbcsPlanType.RetrieveOptions).
    PbcsDataImportException
    Thrown when there are rejected cells during a data import operation and the import options have been configured to throw an exception on rejected cells.
    PbcsGeneralException
    A general-purpose exception thrown when the REST API returns an error that doesn't warrant a more specific exception type.
    PbcsInvalidCredentialsException
    Thrown when the PBCS REST API rejects the supplied credentials.
    PbcsInvalidDimensionException
    A specialization of the "no such object" exception that is specific for when a dimension is invalid.
    PbcsInvalidMemberException
    Thrown when a member name is invalid.
    PbcsJobLaunchException
    Thrown when an unexpected error occurs while launching a job.
    PbcsKnownInvalidMemberException
    Thrown when a PbcsPlanType.MemberResolver knows (or thinks it knows) that a given member is invalid.
    PbcsMemberAddException
    Thrown when PbcsApplication.addMember(String, String, String) fails because the given parent member is not enabled for dynamic children in the outline.
    PbcsNoSuchClientException
    This exception is thrown when a Hyperion Planning API version is requested but does not exist (in the REST API, a 404 is/should be thrown).
    PbcsNoSuchFileException
    Thrown when a requested file does not exist on the remote system.
    PbcsNoSuchObjectException
    General exception thrown when an object doesn't exist (but generally should).
    PbcsNoSuchVariableException
    Thrown when a requested substitution variable does not exist for the given application.
    PbcsServiceUnavailableException
    Thrown when the PBCS environment is currently unavailable, such as when it is in maintenance mode.
